sentences.text: It is submitted by learned counsel appearing for appellant that appellant is in jail since 21.07.2023.
Investigation is complete and charge sheet has been filed.

It is further submitted that allegations were made that appellant made false promise to prosecutrix to do marry and thereafter,
committed rape with her.
Prosecutrix has also lodged one more case against another person.
She is a consenting party and she is major.
Hence, appellant may be granted bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate appearing for State opposed the bail application.
It is submitted that prosecutrix is tribal.
False promise was made to her and she believed the commitment of appellant and thereafter, agreed to enter into relationship.
In these circumstances, offence of rape has been committed by appellant.
5. Counsel appearing for objector also opposed the application for grant of bail.
It is submitted that appellant is trying to influence the prosecutrix and forcing her not to give her evidence.

6. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case and taking into consideration the age of appellant and also the prosecutrix and nature of allegation made against the appellant, I find it to be a fit case for grant of bail with following conditions :-
(i) Appellant will not try to contact the prosecutrix through himself or his friends and agent,
(ii) if appellant makes such effort or try to influence, then prosecutrix is at liberty to file an application before the trial Court which shall be considered by the trial Court on merits and trial Court will be at liberty to send the appellant in jail, if any such effort is made by him to prosecutrix or witnesses.
8.
Accordingly, criminal appeal filed by appellant is allowed on condition that he will mark his presence on first of every month before concerned police station.

9. It is directed that on furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) by the appellant along with two solvent sureties in which one should be a local surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of trial Court concerned, the appellant be released on bail.
